clusters.name: Walter's move across the country, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the year: June grew homesick and wrote to her sister Edna daily, Glen began fighting at school, Walter distanced himself working in the trees, Walter and his brother Harlan cut off after a quarrel over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, Walter and June fought over money for new trees, and by September June had joined the church choir and her letters thinned out as her anxiety eased and her functioning improved.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter began drinking heavily, he and Glen blamed each other for the loan and clashed, Glen and Marian took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter, you began wetting the bed in April 1969, and by October Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within a year: Glen sat in the truck in the yard for hours out of work, he and Marian fought loud fights at night over money, Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night, you stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, you kept to your room and distanced from your mother, Walter began drinking again after six years off it, and by June 1976 you were eating again and made the track team.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Sam's mother Wilma moving into your house in January 1990 after selling her farm: you clashed with her over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam worked late and distanced himself from the kitchen rows, Sam took his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice, Wilma took over Lily's care, you developed eczema on both hands, you and Sam had rows most nights, and by summer 1991 when Wilma took a flat in town the eczema cleared.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess beginning to drink most nights in October 1996: you phoned her every night worried for her, you paid her rent and kept Jesse most weekends, Tess and Rick had shouting matches and Rick slept at his brother's for a month, and by June 1997 Tess stopped drinking and went to meetings twice a week.
